title: chat-server: Space/set destroy lacks manage_space gate
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Destroying a Space: "The caller MUST hold "manage_space" ... Servers MUST return a forbidden SetError when the caller does not satisfy the deployment's destroy-authorization rules." handle_space_set's destroy loop (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs ~L1441-1480) calls destroy_object::<Space> with no permission check, and MemoryBackend::destroy_object does none either, so any caller can destroy a Space (and, since a598b13e, all its channel Chats and Messages). Found while working JMAP-x2gd.59.
notes: Folded into JMAP-y3f2 (Chat core server conformance (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00)) by the 2026-10-19 spec gap audit.
